## Problem

What user or interoperability problem does this change solve?

## Change

Describe the implementation and any matching, policy, security, or compatibility effect.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests cover the intended case.
- [ ] A nearby non-match or failure case is covered where relevant.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] User-facing documentation is updated.
- [ ] Fixtures contain only synthetic or license-safe data.
